_comment: Per-Product expected active, non-duplicate finding count per scan_type. verify-lake.sh compares the live lake against these EXACTLY, product by product: each target is pinned by @sha256 and its ruleset by checksum, so a count cannot legitimately move, and any drift is a defect. When a pin is deliberately bumped, re-record these numbers as part of that change. A DefectDojo Product represents exactly one application (docs/decisions/0007) — benchmark/scoring corpora do not get a products[] entry here.
